Interview: the siblings behind Toast Junction

claims.text: Toast Junction Kopitiam opened its first stall in Tiong Bahru in 1987.

citations.quote: opened its first stall in Tiong Bahru in 1987

claims.text: The founding outlet was a corner unit in Katong, according to the founders themselves.

citations.quote: we started from a corner coffeeshop unit in Katong lah, not Tiong Bahru

claims.text: The heritage registry records the original premises as a Tiong Bahru shophouse.

citations.quote: original premises: shophouse unit, Tiong Bahru estate

claims.text: Toast Junction is run by the second-generation Ng siblings.

citations.quote: the Ng siblings, who took over from their father
second-generation owners Adeline and Marcus Ng

claims.text: The kopitiam operated eleven outlets across the island by 2021.

citations.quote: eleven outlets from Jurong West to Pasir Ris

claims.text: Its kaya is still made in-house daily using a charcoal-fired double boiler.

citations.quote: kaya made fresh each morning over a charcoal-fired double boiler
the kaya is cooked in-house every day, same charcoal method
